$comment: Gemini responseSchema for the topic→prompt call. Use with responseMimeType: 'application/json'. Field order here is deliberate — the model fills fields in order, so reasoning-bearing fields come before the ones that depend on them.

media_prompt.description: Self-contained prompt for Veo 3.1 or Imagen. 60-120 words. Ordered subject, action, setting, camera, lighting, colour, audio.

caption.description: Post caption. First line is the hook, under 125 characters. Ends with the supplied keyword CTA. No hashtags.

hashtags.description: Exactly 8 lowercase hashtags without the # symbol.

alt_text.description: One sentence describing the visual for accessibility and for the Facebook post.

dials_used.description: Echo of the dial ids received in the input. Verified programmatically against the input. All 16 keys must be present; for image posts, reel-only dials are echoed as an empty string.

uniqueness_rationale.description: One sentence naming the specific dials that differentiate this post from the recent posts supplied in the input.

dial_conflict.description: Empty string if the dial combination worked. Otherwise name the dial and why it fought the topic. Logged to the database to learn which combinations are unusable.
